title: Name/secure pedagogy/standards reviewer (blocking gate role)
context: Every lesson plan published by this project must pass a mandatory pedagogy/standards review gate conducted by a qualified educator. That reviewer role does not yet exist. Until a named, credentialed pedagogy/standards reviewer is confirmed, no plan can be reviewed or published — making this the single most blocking dependency in M0. The reviewer must be a certified teacher or curriculum specialist who can independently verify: that objectives are sound and age-appropriate, that standards alignments are correct (no fabrications), that the procedure is teachable in the stated time, that the answer key is correct, and that UDL/differentiation is present and meaningful.
objective: Identify, recruit, and secure a commitment from at least one named pedagogy/standards reviewer who meets the credentialing bar, agrees to the gate artifact protocol, and is available to review the M0 pilot plan.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one named pedagogy/standards reviewer is confirmed and documented (name, credentials, scope, availability, and contact on record with the maintainer).
The reviewer meets the credentialing bar: certified teacher, curriculum specialist, or equivalent qualified educator.
The reviewer has read and agreed to the gate artifact protocol (what they must verify, what constitutes sign-off, and how they record it).
The reviewer is available to conduct the M0 pilot-plan review (teacher-lesson-plans-pilot-008) before that task can be declared done.
A short written record (committed document or maintainer-held note) captures the reviewer's name, credentials, scope, and contact — no PII beyond what the reviewer consents to make semi-public.
resources: TASKS.md — M0 Milestone table and Definition of Done
PLAN.md — §Quality, review & risk gates (gate 2: Pedagogy & standards review gate)
output: A committed document recording that the pedagogy/standards reviewer role is filled: reviewer name, credentials, scope, availability, and gate-artifact protocol agreement — enabling teacher-lesson-plans-pilot-008 to proceed.
